title: Vegetable Empanadas with Indian Twist
description: A fusion of Venezuelan empanadas with Indian spices, filled with sautéed vegetables. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Roll out the Venezuelan dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped spring onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the ginger paste, cumin powder, and red chili powder to the pan. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped cilantro to the pan and cook for another minute.
Place a tablespoon of the vegetable mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
